mentions.name: Non-chronological RSS reader
mentions.description: A non-chronological RSS reader that crawls the blogrolls of blogs the author likes, fetches all posts with full text, and runs a clustering algorithm over them. LLMs classify the content to filter out meta, political, and personal posts, and an LLM names each cluster by sampling its contents, surfacing decades of long-form blog posts worth reading.
mentions.source_excerpt: I "wrote" (vibe-coded) a non-chronological RSS reader. I crawled the blogrolls of some blogs I liked, fetched all the posts (with full text) and ran a clustering algorithm on them. LLMs classify the content to filter out meta/political/personal posts. And a LLM gives names to the clusters by sampling the contents.
